results.title: MnDOT EV Site Parcels View
results.description:
The MnDOT EV (Electric Vehicle) Site Parcels layer is an export of parcels from the Minnesota Geospatial Commons Open Parcels and Todd County GIS parcels.  The parcels are used to identify property ownership along the 1-mile drive distance from the potential exit site locations to meet the NEVI (National Electric Vehicle Infrastructure) program requirement.

Contact Person: Beth Kallestad  (she/her)
Email: elizabeth.croteau.kallestad@state.mn.us

This data is typically updated on a monthly basis.
results.snippet: The MnDOT EV (Electric Vehicle) Site Parcels view layer was created for the MnDOT NEVI (National Electric Vehicle Infrastructure)  Plan from the Minnesota Geospatial Commons Open Parcel Dataset and Todd County GIS.
